text:
laura: Quick thread to finalize Helix POC handoff. Need to confirm: success criteria, data delivery method, SQ items, and temporary capacity for burst testing. Proposed window: 10 business days (ingest + 5k eval prompts).

sam: Proposed success criteria: 1) p95 < 450ms for 512-token prompts, 2) end-to-end relevance >= 82% on stratified eval, 3) no PHI/PII in outputs (automated redaction checks). Can we commit to providing the scoring harness?

anna-cust: Yes those look fine. We'll provide a CSV with id,prompt,expected_answer,source_type. We prefer to host the data in our S3. Can you support cross-account read-only role?

infra: We can support either: (A) cross-account IAM role limited to prefix (preferred), or (B) presigned PUT into our test bucket. Note: cross-account requires their account to add our role ARN; presigned avoids cross-account but needs them to upload. If they require VPC peering for egress restrictions, that changes timeline.

laura: Customer also sent parts of their security questionnaire (SQ-2971). They want proof data is redacted before leaving their environment. Recommend we provide a client-side redaction helper + guidance.

sam: I'll attach a compact redaction snippet they can run locally. It's intentionally conservative for POC:
```python
import re

def redactor(s):
    s = re.sub(r"\b\d{3}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b", "[REDACTED_SSN]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"[A-Za-z0-9._%+-]+@[A-Za-z0-9.-]+\.[A-Za-z]{2,}", "[REDACTED_EMAIL]", s)
    s = re.sub(r"\b\d{12,19}\b", "[REDACTED_NUMBER]", s)
    return s
```
Run this over the CSV before upload. It's not exhaustive but satisfies initial SQ checks.

anna-cust: Good. For eval plan: we'll include category tags so you can report per-class accuracy. We'll deliver 3k rows initially and hold back 2k for blind testing. OK?

infra: That works. For scoring we'll use fuzzy-token overlap (>=0.8) and exact-match for structured fields. We'll send the scoring harness as a zip.

laura: Pricing — they asked about burst during load tests. For short trials we can offer a temporary discounted reserved node for the window + a hard spend cap. Sales: can we confirm the cap and refund process for unused days?

sam: Proposed commercial: $500 setup + $150/day reserved pool (50% discount) + standard per-token after cap. Unused reserved days can be pro-rated and credited. I'll draft SOW snippet.

sec-bot: Created ticket SQ-2971-response (TICKET-6033) -> security@redwood. ETA 72h for first-pass.

anna-cust: Timeline check: we expect to deliver the sanitized sample by Thu COB, Redwood to ingest Fri, smoke tests Mon, and full eval Wed. Any blockers?

laura: Action items:
- @anna-cust: upload sanitized CSV to presigned link (we'll send link today)
- @sam: share redaction snippet + scoring harness by EOD
- @infra: provide IAM role ARN and network guidance (egress IPs)
- @laura: draft POC SOW with pricing cap and circulate to customer legal
Meeting to confirm ingest status next Mon 9am PT. :white_check_mark:

sam: I'll also include a tiny local validation script (3 sample prompts) so they can verify the harness before upload.

anna-cust: Thanks all. This plan looks actionable.

laura: Great, thanks. If security insists on no cross-account access we'll switch to presigned-only flow.
